messages.subject: install problem - RHIPE into R
parts:

error when attempting to install RHIPE on a RH5 64bit machine:

messages.author: 17c1fededf492731
messages.subject: Re: install problem - RHIPE into R
parts:
Think you need to run ldconfig or ensure the /usr/local/lib path is
included, see /etc/ld.so.conf(.d) (think Red Hat does not include by
default)

Tom

Error output would be helpful.
have you tried

rhwrite(list(1,2,3),"/tmp/x",N=?) replace ? wth some number
or you can download
http://ml.stat.purdue.edu/rhipe/tmp/Rhipe_0.65.1.tar.gz
and try using that (with / without the N=? fix)

Tell me how it works out.

Cheers
Joy

messages.subject: Re: install problem - RHIPE into R
parts:
Hi Joy,

Error output was exactly the same as in the other thread:

> rhwrite(list(1,2,3),"/tmp/x")
Error in if (is.null(N) || N == 0 || N > length(lo)) N <- length(lo) :
missing value where TRUE/FALSE needed
>

The suggested workaround in the other thread was successful, as
follows:

> rhwrite(list(1,2,3),"/tmp/x",1)
RHIPE: Cleaning up associated server (PID=25592)
Wrote 3 pairs occupying 57 bytes
[1] TRUE
>

As was yours, as follows:

> rhwrite(list(1,2,3),"/tmp/x",N=42)
Wrote 3 pairs occupying 57 bytes
[1] TRUE
>

I've not installed the latest release (65.1) yet. Thank you for the
superlative support!

Best Regards,
David
